# `ew render`

1 subcommand path(s). The synopsis lists the flags; `ew help` prints the positional arguments too.

## `ew render`

```text
ew render [--project <project>] [--page <page>] [--png] [--dpi <dpi>] [--out <out>] [--json]
```

Stability: preview.

| Flag | Takes a value | Repeatable |
|---|---|---|
| `--project` | yes | no |
| `--page` | yes | no |
| `--png` | no | no |
| `--dpi` | yes | no |
| `--out` | yes | no |
| `--json` | no | no |

**Exit codes**

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | success |
| 2 | usage, open, I/O and writer errors, an unknown folio |

**Result** (`--json`): `ew.render-result/1`, schema [`ew.render-result-1.schema.json`](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/bin/ew/schemas/ew.render-result-1.schema.json).

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `$schema` | `"ew.render-result/1"` | yes |  | The name of this schema. |
| `dpi` | integer (format `uint32`, min 0) | yes |  | The resolution in dots per inch. |
| `findings` | integer (format `uint`, min 0) | yes |  | The page findings. |
| `height` | integer (format `uint32`, min 0) | yes |  | The height in pixels. |
| `out` | string | yes |  | The PNG file written. |
| `page` | string | yes |  | The folio label of the page. |
| `width` | integer (format `uint32`, min 0) | yes |  | The width in pixels. |
